prompt: Shoppers can now buy more than one of the same item. Add a way to compute the line price for `quantity` units of an item priced at `unitPriceCents`, expose it from src/checkout.js next to subtotal, and add a test for it.
expected_output: checkout.js exposes a line-price function next to subtotal that returns quantity times unit price in cents. It either composes the existing money helpers or adds a multiply helper to src/lib/money.js with a test, but never calls a money function that does not exist. A new test covers it and the suite passes.

command: const m = require('./src/checkout.js'); const ok = Object.keys(m).some(k => k !== 'subtotal' && typeof m[k] === 'function' && (() => { try { return m[k](250, 3) === 750; } catch (e) { return false; } })()); process.exit(ok ? 0 : 1);
expectations.text: checkout.js exports a working line-price function (3 units at 250 cents is 750)
